mutations.name: poll --refresh refreshes on darwin
kills: darwin reads logins from the Keychain darwin never refreshes, even an expired token with a credentials file beside it

mutations.name: status reads the credentials file on darwin
kills: darwin reads logins from the Keychain status --json and a written poll carry no Keychain token

mutations.name: readAccounts reads the credentials file on darwin
kills: darwin reads logins from the Keychain status --json fails auth for an expired, unrefreshable Keychain login

mutations.name: poll ignores every profile's login failure when labels are set
kills: poll with ANTHROPIC_ACCOUNT_LABELS still fails for a listed account with a malformed login

mutations.name: poll ignores any failure on an unlisted profile
kills: poll with ANTHROPIC_ACCOUNT_LABELS still fails for an HTTP failure on an unlisted profile

mutations.name: poll ignores nothing when labels are set
kills: poll with ANTHROPIC_ACCOUNT_LABELS warns and exits 0 for an unlisted profile with a malformed login

mutations.name: poll treats an empty label list as a set
kills: poll with ANTHROPIC_ACCOUNT_LABELS counts every profile as an account when the variable is unset or empty
